items.title: Introduction
items.body: Status: approved · Revision: 4 · Describes `main` (CR-2, CR-3 and CR-8 folded)

items.title: Contract (`src/contract.ts`)
items.body:
- Responsibility: the shape of everything exchanged; validation with field paths.
- Data model: `ReviewDoc` (zod), `Item`, `Choice`, `Feedback`, `Comment` (`item`, `line >= 0`,   optional `range {start, end, quote}`, `body` or `suggestion`), `Range`.
- Interface: `validateReview(input)`, `validateFeedback(input, doc?)` return `{ok, value}` or   `{ok: false, errors: [{path, message}]}`; `itemLines(item)` gives an item's lines (non-empty body   lines, then question choices as `a) label`, then `Check: …`); `anchorText(doc, item, line)`;   `scopeOf(anchor)` and `inScope(scope, target)`; `DOC` is reserved.
- Errors: duplicate IDs, questions without choices, unknown dependencies, anchors that don't exist,   a range whose quote doesn't match.

items.title: Edit engine (`src/edit.ts`)
items.body:
- Responsibility: change exactly one span in exactly one field.
- Interface: `locate(doc, {item, line, find, replace, start?})` (at `start`, or the single   occurrence); `applyEdit(doc, edit)` returns a new document; `wordStats(find, replace, line)`;   `narrow(text, replacement)` shrinks a whole-line suggestion to the differing words.
- Behavior: `setter` maps an anchor to its field (title, TL;DR, heading, the n-th non-empty body line   keeping its indentation, a choice's label, the check); the result is re-read and compared.
- Errors (`EditError` with a field): not found, ambiguous, line breaks in `replace`, emptying a line,   editing an option's letter, changing a document line's markdown block markers, editing a TL;DR   copied from the first paragraph.

items.title: Markdown (`src/markdown.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `parseMarkdown(md, {title, tldr, slug, channel, review_id})`, `exportMarkdown(doc)`,   `keepIds(prior, next)`, `JOIN` (U+2028).
- Behavior: first `#` heading is the title; ATX and setext headings start sections (`level`);   blocks are paragraphs, list items with continuations, quote lines, table rows, fenced and indented   code, thematic breaks, each one line with source lines joined by U+2028; blank lines between   blocks and around headings kept as empty body lines (not commentable, so anchors don't move);   intro is section `S-0` at level 0; TL;DR defaults to the first paragraph (`tldr_auto`). With   `spacing: "exact"` (a document with a `#` title), export writes headings and bodies verbatim;   without it, one blank line around headings.

items.title: Store (`src/store.ts`)
items.body:
- Data model: `ReviewMeta` (id, slug, title, channel, status open/approved/closed, revisions,   repo_dir, github PrRef, supersedes, decision_files, pr_answers), `Reply`, `Proposal` (id, thread,   revision, item, line, find, replace, start, line_text, words, status), `Applied`.
- Interface: `create`, `addRevision`, `update`, `meta`, `revision`, `feedback`, `allFeedback`,   `addFeedback` (assigns `th_<review>_<n>` thread IDs), `setFeedback`, `replies`, `addReply`,   `proposals`, `writeProposals`, `applied`, `addApplied`, `findThread`, `list`.
- Behavior: atomic writes (temp file and rename); review IDs validated before building paths.

items.title: Core (`src/hoop.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `submit`, `submitAny` (GitHub channel), `feedback`, `feedbackAny` (refreshes GitHub),   `review` (validates new comments against the current revision; replies keep their anchor),   `applySuggestion`, `proposeEdits`, `editPosition`, `decideEdit`, `reply`, `replyAny`, `refresh`,   `writeDecision`.
- Behavior: documents keep section IDs across revisions (`keepIds`); approval freezes and writes   decisions (clean markdown for `kind: "doc"`); accepted spans rebase other proposals on the line;   every action is audited.
- Errors: `HoopError(message, fieldErrors)`; approved, closed and GitHub reviews refuse local edits.
- Since CR-8, `applySuggestion`, `proposeEdits`, `editPosition` and `decideEdit` delegate to the   materializer, and every refusal comes from the review rules.

items.title: Review rules (`src/rules.ts`, CR-8)
items.body: - `editable(store, id, { open, frozen, github })` returns the review or throws. Each caller passes   its own wording for a GitHub review. `thread(store, id, threadId)` returns the first comment, its   revision and every entry. `threadIds` and `existing` sit alongside them.

items.title: Materializer (`src/materialize.ts`, CR-8)
items.body: - The `Materializer` holds apply, propose, decide, edit positions and the rebase of other proposals   on a line. It uses the review rules, the edit engine and the store.

items.title: GitHub (`src/github.ts`)
items.body:
- Interface: `GitHub(gh)` with `open(dir, doc)`, `revise(ref, doc, n)`, `sync(ref, id, revisions)`,   `reply(ref, rootCommentId, body)`; `PrRef` keeps `commits` (sha to revision) and `own_comments`.
- Behavior: commits through the git trees API (the checkout is untouched); maps comment lines through   the rendered line map of the revision they were made on; resolved threads via GraphQL.

items.title: MCP, web, wait, audit, CLI
items.body:
- `src/mcp.ts`: six tools; `failure()` returns errors as tool errors and audits them.
- `src/web.ts`: route table behind Host, Origin and JSON checks; `reviewView` adds item lines,   history per revision, replies, applied edits and proposal positions. `web/app.js` renders;   `review.js` adds comments, threads, Apply, tracked-change cards and Finish; `select.js` handles   selection (ignoring inserted text) and decorations.
- `src/wait.ts`: polls the store (and GitHub every 15 s) until a new review, approval or close.
- `src/audit.ts`: `audit(event, data)` appends; `readAudit`, `summarize` for `hoop audit`.

items.title: Change registry (`src/changes.ts`, CR-3)
items.body:
- Data model: `docs/changes/CR-<n>-<slug>/REQUEST.md` (the request, byte for byte, written once)   and `change.json` `{ id, slug, title, type, reason, created, steps: [{step, at, by}], reviews:   {prd?, hld?, lld?: string[]}, prs: number[] }`. `steps` is append-only; the last is current.
- Interface: `create(text, {type, reason, title?, slug?, by?})` reserves the next number with an   exclusive folder create; `classify(cr, type, reason, {why?})` logs a corrected type to   `CLASSIFICATION.md` before saving; `moveStep(cr, step)` allows only the next step or `closed`,   asks the gate hook, and for fold checks every linked PR with `gh pr view` (injectable);   `linkPr`, `addReview`, `get`, `list`. Folders without `change.json` read as type `unknown`.

items.title: Review sequencer (`src/sequence.ts`, CR-3)
items.body:
- A review is linked to `{cr, doc, repo}` in `ReviewMeta.change`; a revision inherits the link and   can't be relinked. `approved_at` is set on approval (the merge time on GitHub).
- `state(cr)`: each document's current review, status, approval time and staleness (stale when   the document before isn't approved, is stale, or was approved later). `blockers(cr, doc)` before   a review opens; `ready(cr)` for build. `gatedChanges(store, repo)` wires the build gate and keeps   the change's row in `docs/TRACKER.md` (failures are audited, not thrown).

items.title: Tracker service (`src/tracker.ts`, CR-3)
items.body: - The first table whose header has ID and Parent; columns by name. `readTracker(path)` gives   `{columns, items, tree, hash}`; `setCells` and `addItem` rewrite only their row (a missing column   is added on every row), keep each line's ending, refuse a stale `base` hash, and write   atomically through symlinks. `trackerTables(lines)` serves review pages; `insideRepo` confines   paths to the repository.

items.title: Operations and CLI (`src/ops.ts`, `src/cli.ts`, CR-3)
items.body: - `OPS`: `{name, title, description, input (zod), run(hoop, input, {actor}), cli: {command, usage,   parse}}`. MCP registers `hoop_<name>`; the CLI matches the longest command words, takes the   `--name <value>` flags in the usage line (unknown flags refused), validates with the same schema,   prints text or `--json`, and exits 1 with field errors. The CLI acts on the git repository root.

items.title: Tracker pages (`web/tree.js`, `web/tracker.js`, CR-3)
items.body: - `renderTree(key, columns, rows)`: depth-first rows with carets, type badges, status and phase   chips, filters that keep ancestors; rows with comments or edits stay visible. Review pages render   each item's `tables` (from the API) as trees with each row's line anchor and threads.
